risk_description: Improper tyre pressure label in the tank cap may result in the tyre pressure not being identified based on the vehicle load and thus the vehicle operating with insufficient tyre pressure. As a result, the tyre may be damaged, increasing the risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
